reviewer.origin: Claude Agent tool subagent, model sonnet, a fresh context with only this brief and its files, launched 2026-10-26 by session_01Mxpoi6tFT3FgKmBvtGjRtS (the writer's session)

evidence: Read only the named files: GATE-INPUTS.json (the G-S36 entry), HUMANIZATION-TELL-INVENTORY.md (general rules, then every row), then G-S36's DRAFT.txt, CONTEXT.txt and SOURCE.txt, and ADMISSION.json last, after forming my own view. (The harness attached the repository's AGENTS.md text to my first read; I opened nothing the brief does not name and my judgments rest on the named files.) CHANGE: DRAFT.txt is one question, “What’s theirs and what’s mine?”. CONTEXT.txt holds it exactly once, in the closing list of the “Forgiveness without bypass” section, fifth of seven questions, straight after “What shaped the other person(s) into someone capable of that harm?” and before “What does accountability require?”. The replaced “What is theirs? What is mine?” no longer appears, and the approved working-copy question “What boundaries need to be set?” is still there untouched, as the_change says it must be. That matches the_change. The draft's apostrophes are curly, like every other contraction in the section (we’re, doesn’t, can’t, don’t, won’t, you’re), so no typographic seam. MEANING: SOURCE.txt keeps “What belongs to them?” / “What belongs to me?”. The draft asks the same two things (the other person's share, mine) as one compound question; nothing is added or dropped, and there is no new claim, fact or first-person fact. SEAM: read cold, it sits naturally in the list. The contraction and the “and” are slightly more colloquial than “What does accountability require?”, but the section's own voice is casual and contracted, so I hear no second writer, no hedge and no tidy summary. TELL ROWS: T02 is the one row I find actually happening, at paragraph scale: the closing paragraph is a run of seven short questions that each do one clean job and hand off to the next (facts, impact, boundaries, what shaped them, theirs and mine, accountability, letting go). The writer's ledger has T02 ABSENT (“not part of a run of compressed commands”); I read it as part of a run of compressed questions, so I count it PRESENT, but justified here: the run is the form of his own list of self-inquiry prompts, announced as such (“Some questions that may be helpful to ask”); it is there with or without this change; and the draft loosens it, because eight questions become seven and the most staccato moment, two parallel three-word questions in a row, becomes one. T12: the theirs/mine pair is the thought itself, a naturally necessary contrast taken from his own “belongs to them / belongs to me”, not a pair made for balance, so ABSENT. T21: the “and” joins the two halves of one distinction, one job, so ABSENT. T09 and T13 (the pointer in D9): a prompt list is meant to be even and in order, the section notices things elsewhere (“otherwise it can be bypassing”, “It doesn’t make their limitations matter any less”), and the change neither adds a slot-filler nor removes an aside; merging the pair flattens its emphasis slightly, which I judge too small to count. T01: “mine” is the reader's own voice, matching “How can I let this go”, not an authorial stake. T14: same place, same order, nothing moved. T15: a contraction and a join, no rarer words swapped in. T20, T28, T29: it is mid-paragraph, not the closer. C02: “theirs” points to “the other person(s)” in the question directly before it, and “mine” to the reader. T03 to T08, T10, T11, T16 to T19, T22 to T27, C01, C03, C04: ABSENT (no scene, props, filler, setup, negative reveal, colon, coach register, tic words, invented fact or unsupported claim). LINTER: “B7 short landing at paragraph end” is the linter reading the draft alone; in the article it is not the paragraph's end (“What does accountability require?” and “How can I let this go, without denying any of the above?” follow) and it is a plain question, not a quotable closer; accepted. “D9 follows the source order” is by design for a one-sentence swap that has to sit where the replaced words were and keep their points; the T13/T09 check it asks for is above and finds nothing the change introduces; accepted.
